title: Santa Ana annual allowable rent increase 2026-27
requirement: For September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027 a Santa Ana landlord may not raise rent by more than 2.87 percent over the current rent.
coverage_conditions: Residential rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance: annual allowable rent increase
quoted_span: 2.87 percent is the maximum allowable rent increase for the period of September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027.

title: Santa Ana maximum rent increase cap
requirement: Each year a landlord may raise rent by no more than 3% of the current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index change, whichever is less.
key_value: 3% or 80% of CPI change, whichever is less
coverage_conditions: Residential rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance: maximum rent increase cap
quoted_span: Your landlord can only raise your rent by a certain amount each year. The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.

title: Santa Ana just cause eviction requirement
requirement: A landlord must have a valid reason to evict a tenant, such as nonpayment of rent, breaking the lease, or the landlord moving into the property.
coverage_conditions: Residential tenancies covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
quoted_span: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.

title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance rent cap
requirement: Residential rent increases are limited to the lower of 3% per year or 80% of the CPI change over the most recent 12 months; if CPI is negative, no increase is permitted.
key_value: 3% per year or 80% of CPI change, whichever is lower
coverage_conditions: Residential rental buildings and mobile home parks in Santa Ana, other than those exempted by construction date or first offer for rent.

applicability.other: Excludes mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990

exemptions: Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995; mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990; owners may petition for relief showing a greater increase is needed for a fair and reasonable return.
quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.

title: Santa Ana just cause termination requirement
requirement: After 30 days of tenancy an owner may not terminate a tenancy without just cause stated in a written notice, and must first give notice of the violation with time to fix it.
coverage_conditions: Residential tenancies in Santa Ana after 30 days, except the listed exempt property types.

applicability.other: Excludes housing produced in the last 15 years and institutional or shared housing

exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; other shared living quarters.
citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.

title: Santa Ana no-fault relocation assistance
requirement: For a no-fault just cause termination the owner must give the tenant 3 months of relocation assistance or waive rent for the final 3 months of the tenancy.
key_value: 3 months relocation assistance or 3 months rent waiver
coverage_conditions: No-fault just cause terminations under the Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance: relocation assistance
quoted_span: Under a no-fault just cause termination, the owner shall either provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive payment of rent for the final 3 months of the tenancy.
